description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a test application for a Thunder framework plugin. It defines a PluginHost class managing connection initialization, deinitialization, tracing, and syslog functionalities, and includes a main function that provides a command-line interface to invoke these methods.

classes.name: PluginHost
